info.name: Resolvia APIs
info.description: Auto-generated collection of all 157 APIs in server.js. Organized by HTTP Method.

item.name: 1. GET Requests (Read-Only & Safe)
item.description: These requests only retrieve data. They will not mess up any existing data in your database.

item.name: 2. POST Requests (Create Data)
item.description: ⚠️ CAUTION: These requests add new data (e.g. creating users, submitting complaints). Running these might create test data in your database.

item.name: 3. PUT Requests (Update Data)
item.description: ⚠️ CAUTION: These requests update existing data. Be careful as they might change actual user data or complaints.

item.name: 4. DELETE Requests (Remove Data)
item.description: ⛔ DANGER: These requests will permanently delete data from your database (e.g. deleting staff, discarding found items).
